name: California

items.label: California income tax
items.note: Less the personal exemption credit of $153 per person, which shrinks by $6 per $2,500 of income above $252,203 ($504,411 married). Includes the 1% Mental Health Services Tax on taxable income over $1 million.

items.label: State Disability Insurance (SDI)
items.note: 1.3% of all wages — there has been no wage ceiling since 2024.

provisional: Tax brackets, the standard deduction ($5,706 / $11,412) and the exemption credit ($153) are the 2025 figures; California publishes the 2026 inflation-adjusted amounts late in the year
